description: Données sur les installations photovoltaïque en France et quelques pays Européens is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Association ASSO BDPV. These datasets come from the BDPV website ( BDPV is a free website that allows photovoltaic owners to track their production over the years and compare it to nearby installations. The site also helps Internet users to know the production of their future installation. Coverage: Association ASSO BDPV. The portal shows the English title as "Data on photovoltaic installations in France and some European countries" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Association ASSO BDPV. Its keywords include solaire, energies-renouvelables, energie-solaire, panneaux-solaires, transition-energetique, energie-production. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
